Definition: from G545; disbelief (obstinate and rebellious):--disobedience, unbelief.
BiblicalUsage: Disobedience — the wrath of God coming on the children of disobedience, the spirit working in them now, and the mercy shown to us who once were disobedient too. Paul will not let me forget I was one of them before mercy found me.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe disobedience is never just breaking rules; it is refusing the God who made me. And I hold that the mercy I received is the only reason I can now obey with joy instead of fear.
